memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: New diagnosis, symptomatic fatigue.
  - Plan: Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food; check weight and waist; advise iron-rich diet; review in 3 months.
- Weight: 78 kg
- Waist circumference: 92 cm (above male cutoff 90 cm).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – include fortified cereal and orange juice; Lunch – dal with leafy greens and meat; Dinner – light, avoid tea with meals.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 9.2 g/dL (Ref: 13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin: 12 ng/mL (Ref: 30-400)
MCV: 78 fL (Ref: 80-100)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling tired through the day, especially after lunch. Taking the tablets as prescribed, no side effects noticed.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Improved, Hb rising.
  - Plan: Change to ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days after food; continue diet advice; recheck labs in 3 months.
- Weight: 77.5 kg
- Waist circumference: 91 cm (still slightly above cutoff).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – add boiled egg; Lunch – increase beetroot; Dinner – avoid calcium supplements with meals.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days after food

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 11.0 g/dL (Ref: 13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin: 45 ng/mL (Ref: 30-400)
MCV: 82 fL (Ref: 80-100)

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booking: Visit with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) on 2025-10-15 at 10:30 AM.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Near target, Hb approaching normal.
  - Plan: Continue ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days; recheck labs in 3 months; consider stopping if Hb >13 and ferritin >100.
- Weight: 77 kg
- Waist circumference: 90 cm (at cutoff).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – include poha with peanuts; Lunch – rajma with rice; Dinner – early, low‑fat.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin: 12.8 g/dL (Ref: 13.0-17.0)
Serum ferritin: 92 ng/mL (Ref: 30-400)
MCV: 85 fL (Ref: 80-100)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Dr Sumanth Rao, Gastroenterology, for evaluation of possible occult GI blood loss contributing to iron deficiency. Please perform upper GI endoscopy and colonoscopy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral outcome: Gastroscopy showed a small gastric ulcer, treated with PPI; colonoscopy normal. Advised to continue iron supplementation and PPI for 8 weeks.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Hb normal, ferritin adequate.
  - Plan: Stop ferrous sulfate; monitor for recurrence; advise maintenance diet.
- Weight: 76.8 kg
- Waist circumference: 89 cm (below cutoff).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – fruit and yogurt; Lunch – balanced meal with pulses; Dinner – light, avoid late-night snacking.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: ECG: Normal sinus rhythm, no ST‑T changes, rate 78 bpm.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Iron-deficiency anaemia
  - Status: In remission, Hb stable.
  - Plan: No medication needed; repeat Hb in 6 months; continue diet advice.
- Weight: 76.5 kg
- Waist circumference: 88 cm.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – whole‑grain toast with avocado; Lunch – mixed vegetable curry with brown rice; Dinner – soup and salad.
